channel.title: OpenUPM Blog
channel.description: OpenUPM project updates, package manager notes, and Unity package publishing guides.

item.title: Upcoming Unity Editor Change Affecting Package Compatibility: Unity 6.6 Fast Enter Play Mode
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: Unity 6.6 enables Fast Enter Play Mode by default for new projects, so package authors should audit static state and add explicit Play Mode cleanup where needed.

item.title: OpenUPM GitHub Action Publish Wait
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: OpenUPM now has an experimental GitHub Action that can trigger a package refresh from a tag or release workflow and wait until the version is published.

item.title: OpenUPM Trends Page Is Live
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: OpenUPM now has a public trends page for package growth, release activity, signing adoption, publishing modes, downloads, and topic momentum.

item.title: Contributor Profile Pages Arrive on OpenUPM
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: OpenUPM now has contributor profile pages that gather package ownership, discovery activity, profile links, and badge walls into one public profile.

item.title: UnityNuGet Package Pages Now on OpenUPM
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: OpenUPM now generates website package pages for UnityNuGet packages, making org.nuget packages easier to find, inspect, and install from the web.

item.title: OpenUPM Recent Improvements, May 2026
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: A short roundup of recent OpenUPM package page, build reliability, community support, and registry reliability improvements.

item.title: UnityNuGet Search Now Works Through OpenUPM
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: OpenUPM's registry upgrade experimentally makes org.nuget packages visible through registry search while keeping UnityNuGet package resolution behind the OpenUPM endpoint.

item.title: OpenUPM Queue Status Page
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: OpenUPM now has a public queue status page for package scan and release build activity.

item.title: UnityNuGet Packages Are Now Code Signed

item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: Unity 6.3 package signing lets package authors ship signed tarballs through GitHub Releases while OpenUPM republishes the exact artifact.

item.title: OpenUPM 2025 Recap
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: A year-end look at OpenUPM package submissions, downloads, release activity, fast-growing packages, and the rise of AI tooling in 2025.

item.title: OpenUPM Launches Alternative UnityNuGet Registry
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: OpenUPM introduces an alternate UnityNuGet hosting endpoint so Unity projects can continue resolving org.nuget packages after the Azure feed shutdown.

item.title: DigitalOcean Sponsorship 2024
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: DigitalOcean continued its sponsorship of OpenUPM, providing credits that support the website and related infrastructure.

item.title: Host Your First Private UPM Registry in Just 15 Minutes
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: A short guide for setting up a private Unity Package Manager registry with Verdaccio and a small cloud server.

item.title: OpenUPM x Hacktoberfest 2023 Round-ups
item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
item.description: A recap of OpenUPM's Hacktoberfest 2023 work, including package hunters, community submissions, and site improvements.

item.dc:creator: Favo Yang
